title: Teralizer: A Tool for Generalizing JUnit Tests into Property-Based jqwik Tests
abstract: arXiv:2611.19242v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Property-based testing validates properties across many generated inputs and can thereby detect regressions that conventional unit tests miss. However, writing property-based tests is challenging for practitioners, which limits their adoption. Tool: Teralizer automatically generalizes JUnit tests into property-based jqwik tests for regression detection. Through single-path symbolic analysis, it extracts from each test execution a path condition, which characterizes the inputs that follow the same execution path, and a symbolic output expression, which computes the expected output for these inputs. The generalized tests generate inputs that satisfy the path condition and use the symbolic output expression as the oracle. Results: In our evaluation, generalization increased the mutation scores of EvoSuite-generated test suites by 0.8 to 3.9 percentage points. translated_title: Teralizer：一个将JUnit测试泛化为基于属性的jqwik测试的工具
translated_abstract: 背景：基于属性的测试通过在大量生成的输入上验证属性，能够检测出传统单元测试遗漏的回归缺陷。然而，编写基于属性的测试对从业者而言具有挑战性，这限制了该技术的实际应用。工具：Teralizer能够自动将JUnit测试泛化为用于回归检测的基于属性的jqwik测试。通过单路径符号分析，它从每次测试执行中提取一个路径条件（刻画遵循同一执行路径的输入特征）和一个符号输出表达式（为这些输入计算期望输出）。泛化后的测试会生成满足路径条件的输入，并将符号输出表达式用作测试预言。结果：在我们的评估中，泛化使EvoSuite生成的测试套件的变异得分提高了0.8至3.9个百分点。在EqBench基准测试中，泛化EvoSuite生成的测试套件……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: Teralizer通过单路径符号分析自动将JUnit测试泛化为基于属性的jqwik测试，在输入生成与输出预言两个层面增强测试，从而显著提升回归检测能力。
en_tdlr: Teralizer automatically generalizes JUnit tests into property-based jqwik tests using single-path symbolic analysis, providing both input generation and test oracles to improve regression detection.
